chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Abdul Malik Bin Utba Al Hashimy who said,

I asked Abu Al-Hassan (peace be upon him) about the old man and the old woman who are weakened from the Fasting during the Month of Ramazan. He (peace be upon him) said: 'They should give in charity every day with a handful of wheat'.
ai.seo_question: What is the compensation for elderly people who cannot fast in Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the specific mechanism of fidyah for the elderly who suffer from chronic weakness rather than temporary illness, establishing a daily charitable obligation of one mudd of wheat. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling underscores the principle of ease (taysir) and distinguishes permanent incapacity from temporary absences, ensuring that the elderly are not burdened beyond their physical capacity while maintaining their spiritual connection to Ramadan through consistent charity.
